sentences.en: The tribe wasn't delighted about the advent of the peacemaker.
sentences.zh: 部落对调解人的到来并不高兴。

sentences.en: Carriages gradually disappeared with the advent of the motorcar.
sentences.zh: 随着汽车的出现，马车逐渐消失了。

sentences.en: Before the advent of video games children played cowboys and Indians.
sentences.zh: 在电子游戏出现之前，孩子们玩的是牛仔和印第安人游戏。

senses.zh: 出现,到来,基督降临节（圣诞节前的四个星期）
